content_sections.heading: About IIT BHU
content_sections.text: The Indian Institute of Technology (BHU) is a technical institute in Varanasi. This JRF post belongs to its Department of Pharmaceutical Engineering and Technology. The project is funded by the National Mission for Clean Ganga. The notice gives its full title as "Characterization of Microbes and Micro-pollutants in the Ganga Basin: A Fingerprint Analysis Approach Based on the water sources and their implication in the Ganga Basin". The notice also says the post is part of the Smart Laboratory on Clean Rivers (SLCR) project.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice gives this essential qualification for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF): M. Pharm, M.S.(pharm.), M.Tech (pharm) in Pharma/Medicinal chemistry, Natural product Pharmacognosy, Analysis, etc with GATE/GPAT/CSIR-NET equivalent examination. Experience: Prior research experience in the relevant research fields. Experience in Analytical, HPLC, LCMS and Spectroscopic characterization is desirable. Microbial experience: collection, DNA isolation, Sequencing. Research Skills: Understanding of Sample preparation, water quality assessment, and environmental science. Technical Skills: Proficiency in statistical software, data analysis tools. Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills for reporting and presenting research findings. Analytical Skills: Good problem-solving skills and the ability to interpret complex data. Personal Qualities: Detail-oriented, proactive, and eager to contribute to innovative research solutions. The upper age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is 28 years. The post table gives a relaxation of 5 years to "SC/ST/Physically Handicapped Female candidates". The general conditions add that relaxation of marks and age may be granted to SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Women/physically challenged candidates as per GOI norms. All things being equal, SC/ST candidates will be preferred as per GOI rules. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, see the official notification. content_sections.heading: IIT BHU Junior Research Fellow (JRF) Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice says the JRF will work on scientific research and help develop new solutions for identifying micro-pollutants and microbes in small rivers. The work covers quantitative and qualitative analysis of micro-pollutants and microbes. The JRF will work closely with the other JRF and PA. The JRF will be responsible for: Design and execute the experiment, data acquisition and analysis, and preparation of project report and manuscripts. Research Support: Expertise in advanced analytical method for water quality assessment, knowledge of sophisticated state-of-art technology (Spectroscopic Techniques). Data Management: Analyse complex data sets and provide strategic insights to inform project decisions. Report Preparation: Prepare comprehensive research reports, Papers, Posters and technical reports.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT BHU JRF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is 01 Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post, in the NMCG-sponsored project at the Department of Pharmaceutical Engineering and Technology, IIT (BHU).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT BHU JRF post?
faq.answer: The notice gives 21 November 2026 as the last date of application. Its application procedure asks for the email application on or before 25 November 2026. Applications started on 25 October 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the IIT BHU JRF post?
faq.answer: You need an M. Pharm, M.S.(pharm.) or M.Tech (pharm) in Pharma/Medicinal chemistry, Natural product Pharmacognosy, Analysis, etc, with GATE/GPAT/CSIR-NET equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the IIT BHU JRF post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 28 years. The post table gives a relaxation of 5 years to SC/ST/Physically Handicapped Female candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT BHU JRF?
faq.answer: The JRF gets a fixed Stipend/Fellowship/Salary of ₹37,000/- per month plus HRA.

faq.question: Q6. Is HRA paid on top of the ₹37,000 fellowship?
faq.answer: Yes. HRA is paid on top of ₹37,000/- per month, and it will be given as per Government norms.

faq.question: Q7. Who gets a relaxation in age or marks?
faq.answer: Relaxation of marks and age may be granted to SC/ST/OBC/EWS/Women/physically challenged candidates as per GOI norms. The post table gives 5 years of age relaxation to SC/ST/Physically Handicapped Female candidates.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for the IIT BHU JRF post?
faq.answer: Email the filled application form and all documents as a single PDF to [email protected]. You must also fill in and submit the Google form given in the notice.

faq.question: Q9. What should I write in the email subject line?
faq.answer: Write the post you are applying for in the subject line, such as "Application for JRF_Emerging_2026".

faq.question: Q10. Is the IIT BHU JRF post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is full-time, purely temporary and co-terminus with the project. The tenure is tentatively one year, and the position may be extended for the total project duration.
